configuration.method: ReleaseSafe, Zig0.16.0, AppleM2Pro/macOS27.2; fresh local/global Zig compile caches for cold observations, OS file cache not claimed cold; native build and emitter invocation timed separately. configuration.oracle: Unchanged64 installation source yields2080; controlled emitter constant64->65 yields2145. Components preserve183/184 results and cleanup83; client edit+1 yields184/185; unchanged objects remain byte-identical.
configuration.acceptance: Report all build costs, including cold regressions. Component client edit must not re-emit libraries; standalone links have zero source checking/lowering; forced component recompilation is separately timed. These measurements alone do not close other performance requirements.
configuration.cacheScope: Cold observations start with empty local/global Zig compile caches. OS/dyld caches are not cold. Component-owner initial build occurs later in a workflow with a warmed global toolchain cache.
configuration.firstEmission: The first post-build launch is retained separately. Normal BPI2 precedes BPC1 in predecessor runs; BPC1 first-per-format timing is not an OS-cold first launch.
configuration.timingScope: Native build and producer-process clocks are separate. Producer/link clocks include process startup, source construction where applicable, checking/lowering/linking, encoding and stdout. They are not isolated compiler-pass timings or tail percentiles.

producerObservations.method: Four observations per revision: two rounds in each of two alternating windows. Cold means empty Zig compile caches, not a cold OS file cache. Native build and prebuilt producer process clocks are separate. Each emission uses two warmups and five process samples; every image is byte-stable and executes to the independent expected sum.

setup: Create a fresh absolute experiment directory.
Archive the specified Boundary commits into boundary-before and boundary-after; archive Agent7d415c7 into agent and apply agentBuildPatch. No source is changed in the original repositories.
Write producerBuildSource and producerSource into driver/build.zig and driver/producer.zig.

Extract producerScript and componentScript into that directory. Set BASELINE_AGENT, BASELINE_RUNTIME and CURRENT_RUNTIME to frozen authenticated source/runtime inputs; BOUNDARY_ARCHIVE is the authenticated archive of Boundary711325d.
Run producerScript, then componentScript serially on an otherwise idle host. Scripts create exclusive per-observation directories; never reuse a prior output root.
Controlled edits occur only inside copied sources: installation count64->65, Agent client bonus0->1, component counter41->43.

limitations: Four matched Boundary observations per revision and two component workflows do not establish universal build latency.
Native source edits still cost about10.4s for the matched Boundary producer and14.7-14.9s for this Agent client.

The prebuilt client compiler removes native recompilation for the specifically supported +1 configuration edit, producing byte-identical output. This does not imply arbitrary source edits avoid native compilation.
No full predecessor component workflow exists: component build figures are reported separately, not presented as a like-for-like old/new speedup.
No paid model calls, real user data, World compilation inside the authoring tools, or runtime policy changes.
Runtime performance gaps, remaining workload measurements and legacy retirement, and serial review closeout remain open.
